source_of_truth: Restricted KTL Google Sheets managed by Apps Script

workflows.purpose: Create or update an internal recruitment record in an authorized Restricted Notion data source.
validation: Use only the Team Review allowlist
Search by Submission ID before create
Reject writes from Notion back to approval fields

zapier.trigger: Google Sheets: New or Updated Spreadsheet Row in Team Review
actions: Notion: Find Data Source Item by Submission ID
Path: update the found item or create one item
Google Sheets: write a minimal execution result to an automation log
zapier.error_policy: Use Zap run history; manually replay on Free or use paid Autoreplay; never include row payloads in alerts.
zapier.subscription: Professional or higher because this is a multi-step Zap; Free supports only one action.

make.trigger: Google Sheets: Watch New Rows or Watch Changes in Team Review
actions: Notion: Search Objects/Data Source Items by Submission ID
Router: update found item or create one item
Google Sheets: write a minimal execution result to an automation log
make.error_policy: Break handler plus incomplete execution; retry rate-limit and connection errors; enable confidential data handling.
make.subscription: Build/test on Free, but polling alone can exceed 1,000 monthly credits and Free allows only two active scenarios.

workflows.purpose: Generate a privacy-minimized application summary from an approved template and store the PDF in a Restricted Drive folder.
workflows.source: Private Applications through a dedicated allowlist
validation: Do not export contact, accessibility, token, or file-reference fields
Search the Restricted report folder by deterministic filename before create

zapier.trigger: Google Sheets: New or Updated Spreadsheet Row that meets the approved report condition
actions: Google Docs: Create Document From Template
Google Drive: Export File as PDF
Google Drive: Upload the PDF into the pre-shared Restricted folder
Google Sheets: write a minimal execution result to an automation log
zapier.error_policy: Stop on template/export/upload failure; replay only after deterministic filename lookup prevents duplicates.
zapier.subscription: Professional or higher because more than one action is required.

make.trigger: Google Sheets: Watch New Rows or Watch Changes
actions: Google Docs: Create a Document from a Template
Google Drive: Download/Export the document as PDF
Google Drive: Upload the PDF into the pre-shared Restricted folder
Google Sheets: write a minimal execution result to an automation log
make.error_policy: Use a Break handler and incomplete execution; resume only after filename dedupe check.
make.subscription: Free can prototype files up to 5 MB; Core increases file size and permits unlimited active scenarios.

workflows.sharing: Grant named KTL staff access to the parent Drive folder; do not create public or anyone-with-link permissions per report.

workflows.purpose: Add or update a Mailchimp audience member only after separate explicit marketing consent.
workflows.source: Private Applications through a dedicated consent gate

field_map.marketing_consent: Eligibility gate only; not a tag

validation: Require marketing_consent === true from a dedicated field
Find existing member by email before add/update
Never resubscribe an unsubscribed member automatically
Use pending/double-opt-in for a new member

zapier.trigger: Google Sheets: New or Updated Private Applications row after consent field exists
actions: Mailchimp: Find Subscriber
Filter/Path: skip unsubscribed or withdrawn; add/update eligible member and role tags
Google Sheets: write a minimal execution result to an automation log
zapier.error_policy: Do not retry consent or unsubscribe failures; retry transient provider failures only after subscriber lookup.
zapier.subscription: Professional or higher because lookup, branching, update, and result logging are multi-step.

make.trigger: Google Sheets: Watch New Rows or Watch Changes after consent field exists
actions: Mailchimp: Search Members
Filter/Router: skip unsubscribed or withdrawn; add/update eligible member and role tags
Google Sheets: write a minimal execution result to an automation log
make.error_policy: Break on provider failure; never convert an unsubscribe into subscribed during retry.
make.subscription: Can prototype on Free; three continuously active scenarios require Core or consolidation.
